task_description: Add an available-when-supported New York wedding forecast widget and persistent accessible dark mode to the existing wedding itinerary site.

verification.summary: Regression follow-up passed production validation and all 19 Node tests. Browser checks at 320px and 1280px confirmed no horizontal overflow or timeline overlap, clear light and dark theme feedback, responsive one and three-column weather layouts, and typical early-October estimates when live weather is unavailable. No Dockerfile exists.
